We need to count aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? The system may have a sample at hand (the "sample at hand") but we don't know its structure. We need to retrieve something? Perhaps we need to get the carbon NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But easier: maybe we can request the carbon NMR spectra which will list peaks; aromatic carbons appear around 120-150 ppm. But we need count. Could also request HSQC to map. But we don't have the molecule.

Maybe the environment has a default sample? Could be that the tool carbon_nmr_spectra returns a string with peaks and assignments? Let's try to call carbon_nmr_spectra.
